# Manoj Kumar Ethini

> Backend-heavy fullstack developer. Python-first. Ships and deploys end to end.
> Third-year B.Tech CSE student at MLR Institute of Technology, Hyderabad (expected 2028).
> Site: https://manoj-kumarrr.vercel.app

## About

Third-year CSE student interning on his college's production ERP, where he owns the
attendance and HR/leave domain across a 17-portal system used daily by the whole campus.
Outside it he ships and deploys full-stack products end to end — FastAPI + PostgreSQL
backends, Next.js frontends, and LLM/speech pipelines running live on Render, Vercel and
Railway. Comfortable reverse-engineering an undocumented API, wiring payments, and
operating a service inside free-tier memory and connection limits.

## Experience

Software Development Intern — MLR Institute of Technology (Jul 2026 – Present)
Campus Companion, the live college ERP at campushub.mlrit.ac.in. Feature owner across
17 role-based portals in a team of 7, one of the two most active contributors with
115 commits, working through PR review. Owns the attendance and HR/leave domain end to
end — schema, SQL migrations, API routes, UI and release. Built the faculty leave system,
re-architected attendance around per-period sessions, shipped the monthly attendance
report with CSV/Excel export, and delivered features through the team's Supabase to
AWS RDS migration.
Stack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Supabase → AWS RDS), Shadcn UI.

## Projects

- BunkMax — https://bunk-max.vercel.app — Attendance tracker with automated college-ERP
  sync. Subscription SaaS telling students exactly how many classes they can miss.
  Reverse-engineered the ERP's undocumented API, Fernet-encrypted credential storage for
  daily re-sync, Razorpay orders and signature-verified webhooks, 30+ REST endpoints and
  push-notification cron jobs. Code: https://github.com/manojkumar69work-bit/BunkMax

- TruthVortex — https://truthvortex.vercel.app — AI Telugu news aggregator scraping
  ~30 RSS sources across 5 categories into 5–8 line Telugu summaries. Multi-provider AI
  pipeline (OpenRouter primary, Groq fallback), background scraper with fuzzy
  deduplication, per-IP rate limiting and CSP headers.
  Code: https://github.com/manojkumar69work-bit/truthvortex

- Multi-lingual Voice Agent — Speech pipeline with sentence-level TTS streaming, barge-in
  via Silero VAD, and a Hindi language hint on ASR so code-switching does not break it.
  Every call produces a summary, a structured lead and a transcript.
  Code: https://github.com/manojkumar69work-bit/Multi-lingual-Voice-Agents

## Stack

Backend: Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, REST APIs
Frontend: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, Three.js
AI/Speech: OpenRouter, Groq, Sarvam AI, edge-tts, Silero VAD, LiveKit, MediaPipe
Infra: Render, Vercel, Railway, Supabase, Firebase, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Razorpay
Data/Geo: Leaflet, OpenStreetMap (OSRM routing, Overpass), Zerodha Kite Connect, yfinance
